names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Νικόδημος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Σερβίας», with the rank word and the see left off. No Serbian form is recorded: saint.gr prints none.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Νικόδημος κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 1325», and the head line of the same page gives «(; - 1325)». The page gives no year for his birth, only that he was consecrated bishop in 1316.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is none of the four Nicodemi the corpus keeps** — of the Cave, of Tismana, the Hagiorite, Shchapkov — this one was abbot of Chilandar on Athos and then Archbishop of Serbia. **The `serbian` row is left `undocumented` although he is a Serbian saint**, because the Ohrid Prologue was not read: a Serbian saint's own calendar is exactly the source a later reader will want and claiming it unread is the honest state. **`sabbas-the-sanctified` is joined to him by the page's own sentence** — the Typikon he translated in 1319 is «το Τυπικό του Αγίου Σάββα του Ηγιασμένου της Ιερουσαλήμ» — and a Typikon translated is a work and not a dedication. **The relics are in the note and not in `locations`**: «Τα Λείψανα του Αγίου βρίσκονται στο Πατριαρχείο Πεκκίου Κοσσυφοπεδίου», the Patriarchate of Peć in Kosovo, which is a resting place and not a place the page puts his life in. No hymn.

Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). He is a Serbian saint and that calendar is the one that would settle his own day and rank; it was not read.
